files.html: //! monitors - the monitors the platform reports (`z.monitorCount`, `z.monitor`, `z.currentMonitor`): each one's name, //! where it sits on the desktop and its size in its own logical pixels, its scale and its refresh rate; the primary //! marked, and the one holding the window highlighted. Move the window to another monitor and the highlight follows. //! A page sees a single monitor, its screen, and cannot tell its refresh rate. //! //! In a window, keys place it: a digit centers the window on that monitor, M minimizes it, X maximizes it, R restores //! it, and L limits its size to 480 by 320 at least and 1200 by 800 at most - pressed again, it lifts the limits. A //! page cannot do any of these, so the keys are read only where there is a window to place. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Color = zm.Color; const float = zm.float; const State = struct { font: z.Font, is_size_limited: bool = false, }; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 18); s.* = .{ .font = font }; } /// The keys that place the window, on platforms with a window to place. fn placeWindow(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const digit_keys = [_]z.KeyboardKey{ .one, .two, .three, .four, .five, .six, .seven, .eight, .nine }; for (digit_keys, 0..) |digit_key, monitor_index| { if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, digit_key)) { const target: z.Monitor = z.monitor(@intCast(monitor_index)) orelse continue; const window_width: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const window_height: f32 = f.window.heightf(); const left: f32 = @max((target.width - window_width) / 2, 0); const top: f32 = @max((target.height - window_height) / 2, 0); z.setWindowPosition(@intCast(monitor_index), left, top); } } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .m)) { z.showWindow(.minimized); } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .x)) { z.showWindow(.maximized); } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .r)) { z.showWindow(.normal); } if (z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .l)) { s.is_size_limited = !s.is_size_limited; const limits: z.SizeLimits = if (s.is_size_limited) .{ .min_width = 480, .min_height = 320, .max_width = 1200, .max_height = 800, } else .{}; z.setWindowSizeLimits(limits); } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { if (comptime !z.host.is_browser) { placeWindow(f, s); } z.clearViewport(f, .{ .r = 24, .g = 26, .b = 34, .a = 255 }); const white: Color = .{ .r = 240, .g = 240, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const dim: Color = .{ .r = 150, .g = 150, .b = 160, .a = 255 }; const accent: Color = .{ .r = 96, .g = 165, .b = 250, .a = 255 }; const monitor_count: u32 = z.monitorCount(); const current_index: u32 = z.currentMonitor(); f.gl.textf( .{ 24, 24 }, "{d} monitor(s); the window is on monitor {d}", .{ monitor_count, current_index }, .{ .size = 20, .color = white, .font = &s.font }, ); var index: u32 = 0; while (index < monitor_count) : (index += 1) { const described: z.Monitor = z.monitor(index) orelse break; const line_y: f32 = 72 + float(index) * 64; const is_current: bool = index == current_index; const marker: []const u8 = if (is_current) "> " else " "; const primary_note: []const u8 = if (described.is_primary) ", primary" else ""; const name_color: Color = if (is_current) accent else white; f.gl.textf( .{ 24, line_y }, "{s}{d}: {s}{s}", .{ marker, index, described.name(), primary_note }, .{ .size = 18, .color = name_color, .font = &s.font }, ); const detail_format: []const u8 = " at ({d:.0}, {d:.0}), {d:.0} x {d:.0}, scale {d:.2}, {d:.0} Hz"; f.gl.textf( .{ 24, line_y + 26 }, detail_format, .{ described.x, described.y, described.width, described.height, described.scale, described.refresh_hz, }, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim, .font = &s.font }, ); } if (comptime !z.host.is_browser) { const help: []const u8 = if (s.is_size_limited) "1-9: center on a monitor M minimize X maximize R restore L lift the size limits" else "1-9: center on a monitor M minimize X maximize R restore L limit the size"; f.gl.text(.{ 24, f.window.heightf() - 36 }, help, .{ .size = 15, .color = dim, .font = &s.font }); } } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - monitors", .width = 720, .height = 400, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
